config.record_grain: One point-in-time current AFS licence-register entry per CSV row, for one licence holder; not one row per address, condition, prior licence, or legal entity.

fields.evidence: ASIC AFS Licensee Help File p.9: AFS_LIC_ADD_LOCAL is locality from the current principal business address. CSV row 2 sample: SOUTHBANK.
ASIC AFS Licensee Help File p.10: AFS_LIC_ADD_STATE is state from the current principal business address. CSV row 2 sample: VIC.
ASIC AFS Licensee Help File p.10: AFS_LIC_ADD_PCODE is postcode from the current principal business address. CSV row 2 sample: 3006.
ASIC AFS Licensee Help File p.10: AFS_LIC_ADD_COUNTRY is country of the principal business address; non-Australian addresses are shown as International. CSV row 2 sample: Australia.

unmapped_fields.reason: Help File p.8 identifies this as the name of the register to which the record belongs; the supplied canonical subset has no register-name field.

Help File p.8 defines this as the unique AFS licence number (numeric up to 9 digits), not a legal-entity identifier; preserve as string-valued source-record provenance only. The supplied ontology has no licence identifier field.

Retained only via subject_label_field. Help File p.8 calls it a register-entry name and says it may be an individual's given/family names or an organisation name; it is not documented as a registered legal name or trading name.

Help File p.8 says this mixed field contains an ABN if supplied, otherwise an ACN, or null, but does not label type per row. No declarative mutually exclusive type-discriminator is available. It is left unmapped rather than risk asserting both entity.abn and entity.acn for a value that could validate under both schemes; no ACN is inferred from an ABN suffix.
Help File p.8 defines this as the start date of the Australian Financial Services licensee, i.e. licence/licensee timing; it must not map to entity.date_registered.

Help File p.9 defines serialized prior pre-FSR register type and licence number values, potentially multiple and tilde-delimited; no corresponding historical-licence field exists in the supplied ontology.
Help File p.11 defines serialized current licence authorisations/conditions in two formats; no permission or licence-condition field exists in the supplied ontology.

limitations: ASIC Help File p.3 says this is a point-in-time snapshot of publicly available information for current AFS licensees. The CSV has no status field on which to encode a current-licensee row filter; inclusion does not establish legal-entity status, company registration, or deregistration.
The supplied source-envelope publication timestamp is used solely as a publication proxy because no row-level snapshot, statement, or change timestamp is supplied.
AFS_LIC_ABN_ACN is deliberately unmapped pending a documented type-specific discriminator or a declarative exclusive-validation capability. Numeric identifiers are not reformatted or zero-padded.
The register entry may name an individual or organisation (Help File p.8); no legal name, trading name, entity type, or entity status is asserted.

Mapped address components describe only the current principal business address (Help File pp.9-10), not a registered address, branch, service location, or full street address. The documentation says blanks may indicate an address that could not be validated.
AFS_LIC_ADD_COUNTRY may be the non-specific source value International for any non-Australian address (Help File p.10); it is preserved as source text and not converted to a specific country code.
All source-reliability and field-confidence scores are provisional, uncalibrated judgements requiring human review.
